def data(seed, mode):
    r = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    p = 24
    (i, j) = np.triu_indices(p, 1)
    if mode in ('publiclike', 'uneven', 'weakfactor', 'mixed'):
        a = np.eye(p, k=1, dtype=bool)
        a[0, -1] = True
        pool = np.where(~a[i, j])[0]
        ex = r.choice(pool, 4, replace=False)
        a[i[ex], j[ex]] = True
        a |= a.T
    else:
        a = np.zeros((p, p), bool)
        ex = r.choice(len(i), 26, replace=False)
        a[i[ex], j[ex]] = True
        a |= a.T
    S = np.eye(p) * 2.2
    w = np.full(a[i, j].sum(), 0.52) if mode not in ('mixed', 'random') else r.uniform(0.32, 0.69, a[i, j].sum())
    S[i[a[i, j]], j[a[i, j]]] = w * r.choice([-1, 1], len(w))
    S += np.triu(S, 1).T
    if mode == 'random':
        S += np.diag(r.uniform(-0.28, 0.28, p))
        S += np.eye(p) * max(0, 0.55 - np.linalg.eigvalsh(S)[0])
    B = r.normal(size=(p, 2)) * 0.9
    if mode == 'uneven':
        B[:, 0] *= np.exp(r.normal(scale=0.7, size=p))
        B[:, 1] *= np.exp(r.normal(scale=0.7, size=p))
    if mode == 'weakfactor':
        B[:, 1] *= 0.25
    X = r.normal(size=(900, p)) @ np.linalg.cholesky(np.linalg.inv(S)).T + r.normal(size=(900, 2)) @ B.T
    return (X, a, S)

def base(C, lam, typ):
    T = np.linalg.inv(C)
    p = len(T)
    d = np.diag(T).copy()
    E = np.zeros_like(T)
    k = np.median(d)
    if typ == 'cov':
        (l, q) = np.linalg.eigh(C)
        return np.linalg.inv(C - q[:, -2:] * (l[-2:] - 1 / k) @ q[:, -2:].T)
    for it in range(65):
        V = np.diag(d) + E - T
        (l, q) = np.linalg.eigh(V)
        L = q[:, -2:] * np.maximum(l[-2:], 0) @ q[:, -2:].T
        F = T + L
        d = np.diag(F).copy()
        if typ == 'norm':
            th = lam * np.sqrt(np.outer(d, d))
        else:
            th = lam * k
        E = np.sign(F) * np.maximum(np.abs(F) - th, 0)
        np.fill_diagonal(E, 0)
    return F

def evalf(M, a):
    (i, j) = np.triu_indices(len(M), 1)
    d = np.diag(M)
    v = np.abs(M[i, j]) / np.sqrt(d[i] * d[j])
    y = a[i, j]
    fs = []
    for pred in [v > t for t in (0.105, 0.12, 0.135, 0.15)] + [v >= np.partition(v, -k)[-k] for k in (26, y.sum())]:
        fs.append(2 * (y & pred).sum() / (y.sum() + pred.sum()))
    return fs

def profile(C, S):
    from scipy.linalg import cho_solve
    from scipy.linalg import cholesky
    from scipy.linalg import eigh
    from scipy.linalg import solve_triangular
    p = len(S)
    try:
        H = cholesky(S, lower=True, check_finite=False)
    except np.linalg.LinAlgError:
        return None
    D = cho_solve((H, True), np.eye(p), check_finite=False)
    (eig, Q) = eigh(H.T @ C @ H, subset_by_index=(p - 2, p - 1), check_finite=False)
    V = solve_triangular(H.T, Q, check_finite=False)
    t = np.maximum(eig - 1, 0)
    R = C - V * t @ V.T
    obj = np.sum(S * C) - 2 * np.log(H.diagonal()).sum() + sum(np.log1p(t) - t)
    return (obj, R - D, R)

    G = base(C, 0, 'cov')
    p = len(C)
    (i, j) = np.triu_indices(p, 1)
    for (n, U) in [('prec', F), ('cov', G)]:

            S = fit(C, U, lam)
            (_, _, R) = profile(C, S)
            T = np.linalg.inv(R)
            yield (f'{n}{lam}S', S)
            yield (f'{n}{lam}T', T)
            yield (f'{n}{lam}blend', 0.7 * S + 0.3 * T)

    F = base(C, 0.06, 'raw')
    G = base(C, 0, 'cov')
    p = len(C)
    (i, j) = np.triu_indices(p, 1)
    for (name, U) in [('prec', F), ('cov', G)]:
        S = fit(C, U, 0.019)
        (f, _, R) = profile(C, S)
        T = np.linalg.inv(R)
        obj = f + 2 * 0.019 * np.sum(np.hypot(S[i, j], 0.012) - 0.012)
        yield (name, obj, T)

def stats(T, truth, n=900):
    (i, j) = np.triu_indices(len(T), 1)
    y = truth[i, j]
    v = np.abs(T[i, j]) / np.sqrt(T[i, i] * T[j, j])
    order = np.argsort(v)[::-1]
    return [2 * y[v > t].sum() / (y.sum() + (v > t).sum()) for t in (0.102, 0.112, 0.122, 0.132)] + [2 * y[order[:k]].sum() / (y.sum() + k) for k in (26, 28, 30)]
